subject: financial_literacy
concept: Building a comprehensive personal financial plan combining income, taxes, emergency fund, retirement savings, insurance, and spending decisions, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student builds a full simulated financial plan chart allocating income across taxes, emergency fund, retirement, insurance, and spending
exercise.abstract: Student explains their comprehensive plan's reasoning across all major categories

assessment.mastery_threshold: plan reasonably addresses all major categories from this unit
misconception_flags: plan omits a major category (e.g. no emergency fund or retirement allocation at all)

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
